title: MGL router dispatches with a bar-gate, digest, escalation, and a decision ledger.
summary: Was: ad-hoc routing. Now: every dispatch is gated, digested, escalated, logged.
body_md: The MGL router now sits between incoming work and the persona teams. It runs a bar-gate on every request (kill or pass), summarizes into a digest for Pepe, escalates when the confidence drop is too high, and writes every decision to a ledger that Nina audits weekly.
why_this_way: The team keeps growing. Without a dispatch layer, every request becomes a Pepe interruption. With it, only the ones that need Pepe reach Pepe.
